payload.author: experimental_development
payload.hypothesis: The multi_scale_transformer's joint attention over three spatial granularities (scales 2, 4, 7) will outperform the single-scale compact transformer on PathMNIST 28x28 histopathology by simultaneously capturing nuclear-level detail (scale 2, 196 tokens), cell-level structure (scale 4, 49 tokens), and tissue architecture (scale 7, 16 tokens). This multi-granularity view should better resolve the visually confusable class pairs (background/debris/mucus, smooth muscle/stroma, normal mucosa/adenocarcinoma) that account for the remaining ~1% errors, because these distinctions manifest at different spatial scales. Mean pooling over all scales provides a holistic tissue context that cls-token pooling may miss.
